body:
Seems related to the update of  class **org.jboss.resteasy.reactive.client.impl.ClientResponseImpl**

The newer version overwrite the bufferEntity() method to have a specific behaviour when the entityStream is kind of VertxClientInputStream 

```java
public boolean bufferEntity() {
        return VertxClientInputStream.class.equals(this.getEntityStream().getClass()) ? true : super.bufferEntity();
    }
```

The main issue/impact is the "this.buffered" boolean variable that is never set to true.

So the **first time** the readEntity is called, the VertxClientInputStream is read and closed :

https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/a07e8cf1bdd3172cee5beadd72256feaa295f63e/independent-projects/resteasy-reactive/client/runtime/src/main/java/org/jboss/resteasy/reactive/client/impl/ClientResponseImpl.java#L66-L72


But the second time, the checkClosed will raise an exception because stream is closed and this.buffered is false :

https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/7d1cde7f319e197d1fef45fefdbfe6d84fb37e80/independent-projects/resteasy-reactive/common/runtime/src/main/java/org/jboss/resteasy/reactive/common/jaxrs/ResponseImpl.java#L187-L191

Dunno if they have already seen it...
/cc @geoand @cescoffier

issue.title: Synchronous REST Client calls fail with `IllegalStateException: Response has been closed`
issue.body:
### Describe the bug

After fixes introduced in [#48907](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/48907) and https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/48807 synchronous REST client calls started failing with:
`java.lang.IllegalStateException: Response has been closed` 
This occurs only in synchronous client calls that perform blocking operations. Asynchronous calls remain unaffected.

### Expected behavior

Synchronous REST client calls should work as before, without throwing IllegalStateException, and tests should pass.

### Actual behavior

Synchronous REST client calls fail with HTTP 500, due to IllegalStateException caused by the response being prematurely closed.
